Slow by Design

Sustainability

We don't call it sustainable. We call it the only way we know how to make menswear. Real numbers, plain language — read on.

92%

Natural fibres

4%

Cutting waste

12yr

Avg. atelier tenure

0

Air freight

Four commitments

What we promise.

01

Materials

Only what the earth can return.

Linen, cotton, wool, silk, leather. No synthetics that last 200 years longer than the garment they make. Where we use polyester, it is recycled and traceable.

02

Atelier

Fair wages, real names.

Every garment is signed by the maker. Twelve full-time tailors, paid above-market, with healthcare and a four-day week. We have known some of them for a decade.

03

Waste

Cut once, use twice.

Fabric scraps become tote linings, button covers, packaging. Less than 4% of our cutting waste ends up in landfill — and that fraction shrinks every season.

04

Logistics

Carbon-neutral, every parcel.

Every order ships in recycled-paper mailers, sealed with kraft tape. Emissions are offset through a Western Ghats reforestation cooperative we visit twice a year.

Inside the atelier

Six hands per garment.

Western Ghats Project

For every order, a tree.

Since 2021, we have planted 28,400 native saplings across degraded land in Karnataka and Kerala — in partnership with a women-led cooperative that monitors growth and biodiversity year-round. You can adopt a sapling at checkout for ₹49.
